about: Project wallets the ZTPHY holders page labels, on top of the ones read from zetaphy-chain/mainnet/zetaphy_3659-1 (README Allocations, contracts.json), zetaphy-launch/state/3659.contracts.json and the module accounts. To add one: a row with address (0x or zetaphy1), name (at most 60 characters) and kind (multisig, validator, faucet, airdrop, timelock, guardian, deployer, contract or project). A row with an empty address is skipped. A row here wins over the same address read elsewhere. The next daily snapshot (.github/workflows/holders-snapshot.yml) uses it.
